text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: Alas, things are dire. I cannot help striking awe in the others, but it prevents them from accepting my Satsuki Sho challenge! May the goddesses smile upon me…

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: Enter Admire Vega, a passionate fan from my year-end party! It seems she is to run in the Satsuki Sho as well.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: The stage of destiny has been set!
